title: Rokumon Cats
description: Drop chibi cats into the bowl. Matching cats merge into the next tier, up to the moon cat Rokumon.
author: SarutobiSasuke

fields.score: Integer. Merge points (with chain multiplier) plus a crest bonus for the highest tier reached.
fields.highestTier: Integer 0–11. 0 means no cat was placed. 1 is Mote, 11 is Rokumon. Use this for tier leaderboards.
fields.highestTierId: Stable id: mote, kit, pip, miso, nori, mochi, sora, hana, kumo, yuki, rokumon, or null.
fields.highestTierName: Display name of the highest tier, or null.
fields.seed: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD when mode is daily, otherwise null.
fields.merges: Number of successful merges in the run.
fields.maxCombo: Longest chain. A chain is merges within 1.2 seconds of each other.
fields.reason: overflow when the stack stays above the limit line. gameOver is not sent if the player leaves early.
fields.undosUsed: Undos spent this run. Free play allows 3, daily allows 1.
